Title: Ask HN: How do you (AI researchers) convince yourselves that AI isn't terrible?
HN text: Obvious parallels with developing nuclear weapons in the forties. I guess one argument is now, if you don't do it, someone else will, but are there AI researchers who actually believe at this point that this is good for humanity. Because I don't see it. I'll take all the diseases and crt monitors for whatever advances AI is promising at this point.
